hub.title: Desert Progression and Mausoleum Route
hub.description: Marlo Town -> Telepathy Gloves -> Western Desert -> Alchemist Tower -> Mausoleum -> Vampire Adapt -> Necromancer initiation -> Circle of Necromancy -> fusion, summoning, and mutation systems.
hub.quickAnswer: Marlo Town -> Telepathy Gloves -> Western Desert -> Alchemist Tower -> Mausoleum -> Vampire Adapt -> Necromancer initiation -> Circle of Necromancy -> fusion, summoning, and mutation systems.
hub.flowPreview: This flow preview follows the route order from Marlo Town through the western desert, into the Mausoleum dungeon, up to the Vampire Adapt boss, and then into the broader Alchemist Tower systems for Necromancy, fusion, and mutations. The game uses a classic Pokémon-style route gate: the Telepathy Gloves unlock the western path out of Marlo Town. Once in the desert, enemies are around level 18+, so farm materials, level your party, and use rest stops to heal and save. The desert leads to the Alchemist Tower and later the Mausoleum dungeon. The Mausoleum spans six floors: free trapped monsters when prompted, collect keys, handle scheduled encounters, heal before the boss, and defeat the Vampire Adapt on the final floor. Vampire Adapt is not immune to burn, so fire-based attacks are effective. After the boss, complete the initiation ritual to become a Necromancer and unlock the Circle of Necromancy room in the Alchemist Tower, which requires 10 iron bars. From there, progression opens into Necromancy Recipes, Circle of Summoning Recipes, Chimeric Chamber fusion mechanics, Cauldron Recipes, Tier 1 and Tier 2 fusion recipes, additional fusion recipes, and mutation stat effects. The Bone Trail Puzzle is found in the desert near Roaring Mount; start from a colored bone and repeat the action 11 times. Overall, the route moves from linear area gating into a hub-based collection and crafting loop centered on the Alchemist Tower.

leafGuides.preview:
Recipes for crafting essences and mixtures used in summoning and fusion.

1. Combine 5x Goo to create Gooey Concentrate.
2. Combine 4x Scraggy Meat + 2x Goo to create Putrid Mixture.
3. Combine 2x Flame Tendon + 4x Bone to create Ember Gel.
4. Combine 3x Hydro Gland + 10x Salt to create Marine Essence.
5. Combine 8x Condensed Spores + 10x Goo to create Fungal Extract.
